entities.name: USER
entities.rationale: End users interacting with the application via CloudFront.

entities.name: CLOUDFRONT
entities.rationale: Amazon CloudFront content delivery network serving static content and routing API calls.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket configured as origin storage for CloudFront assets.

entities.name: API GATEWAY
entities.rationale: Amazon API Gateway handling HTTP/REST API endpoints.

entities.name: AUTHORIZER LAMBDA
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function acting as a custom Lambda Authorizer for API Gateway authentication.

entities.name: LAMBDA
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function executing backend business logic.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Amazon EC2 instance interacting bidirectionally with the backend Lambda function.

entities.name: DYNAMODB
entities.rationale: Amazon DynamoDB table storing application persistence data.

visual_connections.description: Bidirectional HTTP/HTTPS web request flow between User and CloudFront.
Amazon S3 serves static web assets directly to CloudFront.
CloudFront routes dynamic API request traffic to Amazon API Gateway.
API Gateway triggers the Lambda Authorizer function to validate token credentials.
API Gateway routes authorized API invocations to the primary Lambda backend function.
Bidirectional processing or communication between EC2 and the primary Lambda function.
Lambda function queries and persists application state in DynamoDB.
